questions.q: What does "pivoting" mean in a Smart View worksheet?
options: Deleting all connected data
Rearranging which dimensions appear on rows, columns, or the point of view, reshaping the layout without rebuilding from scratch
Scheduling the worksheet to refresh automatically
Converting the worksheet into a BI Publisher template
questions.explain: Because the data source is multidimensional, dragging a dimension from rows to columns (or vice versa) reshapes the entire view while keeping the same underlying data.

questions.q: What does "drilling" let a Smart View user do?
options: Export the worksheet to PDF
Change the user's security role
Navigate from a summary balance down into the underlying detail that makes it up
Switch to a different Fusion environment
questions.explain: Drilling lets a user investigate a summary number by descending into the transactions or journal lines that produced it, where enabled.

questions.q: What does the "refresh" action do in a connected Smart View worksheet?
options: Permanently deletes the worksheet's layout and formatting
Converts the worksheet into an OTBI analysis
Only works once per day
Re-queries the connected data source and updates the worksheet with current numbers, generally preserving layout and formulas
questions.explain: Refresh pulls current data into the existing worksheet layout, which is why a close workflow can build a layout once and refresh it repeatedly.

questions.q: Which Chapter 1 scenario does ad hoc Smart View analysis most directly answer?
options: "Generate 1099 forms and email them automatically every January"
"Give me a dashboard the AP team can check every morning"
"I need the Income Statement formatted the same way it's always been"
"I want to pull GL balances into Excel myself and build my own variance analysis"
questions.explain: Smart View's live, Excel-native pivoting and drilling is exactly the scenario where a user wants to work the numbers themselves in a spreadsheet.

questions.q: What data source does ad hoc Smart View analysis commonly connect to, the same one used elsewhere in this course?
options: The GL balances cube, the same source Financial Reporting Studio reports against
A standalone CSV file
An OTBI subject area exclusively
A BI Publisher data model exclusively
questions.explain: Smart View commonly connects to the same GL balances cube used by Financial Reporting Studio, just explored interactively inside Excel instead of through a formal report.
